mechanism: Albuterol's beta-2 adrenergic stimulation may be antagonized by chlorpromazine's alpha-adrenergic blocking properties, reducing bronchodilation efficacy; chlorpromazine may increase risk of arrhythmias when combined with sympathomimetics.
action: Monitor respiratory function and cardiac rhythm closely; consider alternative antipsychotic with fewer adrenergic interactions if asthma/COPD control is compromised.
